message.content:
**The Thinker (Le Penseur)** – Auguste Rodin (1880–1902)

Rodin’s bronze “The Thinker” is arguably the most iconic sculpture of the 19th century. Created in the early 1880s and first exhibited in 1884, it captured the imagination of the public and critics alike with its powerful, contemplative pose and the way it embodied the intellectual spirit of the era. The work has since become a universal symbol of thought, creativity, and the human condition, appearing in countless reproductions, parodies, and references across art, literature, and popular culture.
